_meta.description: Topical authority map for innovaretail.co.in. Tracks cluster health, pillar/spoke structure, and gap coverage over time. Updated automatically when new blogs are created via blog_folder_creator.py.

Laptop How-To.authority_goal: Rank for all common laptop troubleshooting and how-to searches in India
Laptop How-To.cannibalization_notes: No pillar defined. Articles are flat — consider creating a 'Laptop Maintenance Guide' pillar.

Laptop Buying Guide — Students.cannibalization_notes: BLOG-022 is pillar. All spokes must link back to it. BLOG-009 (coding) overlaps with BLOG-028 (engineering) — differentiate by use-case depth.

gap_articles.topic: Best HP Laptop for Office Use India 2026

Laptop Buying Guide — Professional.cannibalization_notes: Thin cluster. ZBook is a specific product guide. WFH is a use-case guide. Neither covers the broad office/business buying guide.
